label: Constitutional Amendment 1
what: Bars the governor from granting pardons or commuting sentences from 60 days before a gubernatorial election until the new term begins (the fifth Tuesday after the election). Other clemency powers and the existing requirement to publicly file reasons are unchanged; the section's language is also made gender-neutral.
y: Governors could not pardon or commute sentences in the window around each gubernatorial election.
n: The governor's pardon and commutation power stays available at all times.
pro: Sen. Chris McDaniel (sponsor), Kenton Commonwealth's Attorney Rob Sanders
